taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: A (recomputed from the resistivity sequence: ρ1=14.369 < ρ2=15.965 < ρ3=4591.4 → A, and ρ2=15.965 < ρ3=4591.4 < ρ4=5101.5 → A, giving "AA," which simplifies to a single A-type curve — this corrects the file label of "HA," which does not match the data)
Aquifer depth: ≈9.67 m to beyond 47.74 m (base of the low-resistivity layer 2 into the high-resistivity layers 3–4)
Recommendation: Drill through the thin, low-resistivity clay/sandy-clay zone (0–9.67 m) and set the screen within the thick, high-resistivity sand/sandstone sequence beginning near 9.7 m; since this resistive unit persists beyond 47.7 m with no indicated base, plan for drilling to at least 60–70 m to ensure full aquifer penetration and adequate yield.
